correctness.rationale: For vertex domination each terminal long-arm vertex forces one selected member of {u_i,v_i}; short leaves force either all p leaves without root or root with at least p-1 leaves. Root domination excludes all-terminal choices when p=0. Radial edge signatures force all but at most one arm marked, with the exterior-edge domination condition resolving the p=1 exception. The explicit selected marker codes distinguish vertices/edges. Independent BFS edge/vertex code enumeration exactly matched both optimum cardinalities and both basis counts for twelve (p,q) pairs, p=0..3, q=2..4, including the all-short-absent boundary.
